import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem bounded_predecessor_connected_iUnion {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X}
  (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hPred : ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → (A n ∩ ⋃ k < n, A k).Nonempty) :
  IsConnected (⋃ n, A n) := by
  classical
  let R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop := fun i j => (A i ∩ A j).Nonempty
  
  have hReach : ∀ n, Relation.ReflTransGen R 0 n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
        cases n with
        | zero =>
            exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
        | succ n =>
            obtain ⟨x, hxN, hxPred⟩ :=
              hPred (n + 1) (by omega)
            rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxPred with ⟨k, hxPred⟩
            rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxPred with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
            have hedge : R k (n + 1) := ⟨x, hxk, hxN⟩
            exact (ih k hk).tail hedge
  
  have hSym : Symmetric R := by
    intro i j hij
    simpa [R, Set.inter_comm] using hij
  
  have hChain : ∀ i j : ℕ, Relation.ReflTransGen R i j := by
    intro i j
    exact (Relation.ReflTransGen.symmetric hSym (hReach i)).trans (hReach j)
  
  simpa [R] using
    IsConnected.iUnion_of_reflTransGen
      (s := A)
      (H := hA)
      (K := hChain)

import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem bounded_predecessor_connected_iUnion {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X}
  (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hPred : ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → (A n ∩ ⋃ k < n, A k).Nonempty) :
  IsConnected (⋃ n, A n) := by
  let B : ℕ → Set X := fun n => ⋃ k ≤ n, A k
  
  have hB : ∀ n, IsConnected (B n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simpa [B] using hA 0
    | succ n ih =>
        have hstep : B (n + 1) = B n ∪ A (n + 1) := by
          ext x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n + 1, A k at hx
            rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hx⟩
            rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
            by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
            · left
              change x ∈ B n
              exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hkn, hxk⟩⟩
            · right
              have hkeq : k = n + 1 := by omega
              simpa [hkeq] using hxk
          · intro hx
            rcases hx with hx | hx
            · change x ∈ B n at hx
              change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n + 1, A k
              rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hx⟩
              rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
              exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨le_trans hk (Nat.le_succ n), hxk⟩⟩
            · change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n + 1, A k
              exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n + 1, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨le_rfl, hx⟩⟩
  
        have hinter : (B n ∩ A (n + 1)).Nonempty := by
          rcases hPred (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) with ⟨x, hxA, hxold⟩
          rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxold with ⟨k, hxold⟩
          rcases mem_iUnion.1 hxold with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
          refine ⟨x, ?_, hxA⟩
          change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n, A k
          exact mem_iUnion.2
            ⟨k, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk, hxk⟩⟩
  
        rw [hstep]
        exact ih.union hinter (hA (n + 1))
  
  have hchain : ∀ n, (B n ∩ B (Nat.succ n)).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    rcases (hB n).nonempty with ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n + 1, A k
    change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n, A k at hx
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hx⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
    exact mem_iUnion.2
      ⟨k, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨le_trans hk (Nat.le_succ n), hxk⟩⟩
  
  have hconnB : IsConnected (⋃ n, B n) :=
    IsConnected.iUnion_of_chain hB hchain
  
  have hEq : (⋃ n, B n) = ⋃ n, A n := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨n, hx⟩
      change x ∈ ⋃ k ≤ n, A k at hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨k, hx⟩
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, hxk⟩
    · intro hx
      rcases mem_iUnion.1 hx with ⟨n, hx⟩
      exact mem_iUnion.2
        ⟨n, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨le_rfl, hx⟩⟩⟩
  
  simpa [hEq] using hconnB
